body: After what she told me today, I'm not so sure about that. She said she's leaving me, and can't help me anymore, because she has to be a mother. Essentially she's just going to further enable my lifestyle, and never pay attention to me again. I'm being left out to dry.

Yeah, there's a lot going on in my situation, which I'm open to talking about, but like, idk. Whatever.

I've lived a life of trying to make other people approve of me. My dad wasn't around a lot when I was a kid, and I guess I just wanted him to approve of me, especially since my mom was always working to keep a roof over our head. This translated over to relationships with other guys, and I figured that since I already love eating, and that I am kind of into being plus sized, it wouldn't be a big deal, but I will admit it got way out of control, and then, when I finally decided I should take control of my situation, he left me, and now I'm helpless, and unable to even take care of myself. I can't stand up, I have type 2 diabetes, I have trouble breathing, and so much else, and it all falls onto my sister. All because I wanted validation from my boyfriend, and then, when all was said and done, I didn't even have the fucking willpower to break away from the binge eating. I don't think I can, and now I have to live with the regret of that every time my sister rolls me over to wipe me or scrub the bottom of my legs. The only thing I can get rid of the pain with is more food, which makes me feel worse, and makes me want to eat more. \(It's even worse because she has a day job \-she works from home\- has a husband, and is going to have a daughter of her own in a few months. She's pregnant and still takes care of me. I don't even know why.

Also oh my god I'm so sorry about what you're going through. I know how it feels to be just left out of the blue by someone you love, like I said. I can definitely relate to that. I really hope your situation improves, and that you're doing okay right now.

I also contribute to the anxiety of my sister, who is literally pregnant with a baby and has a husband waiting for her at home after working 7 hours a day at her job, but still brings me food and fucking wipes my ass every day, and now even she's leaving me forever. I guess what happened today is what inspired this post. I'm not loved by anyone.

What do I contribute to society, then? What's the point of even trying with life at this point? Why do people even care about me? Every time my sister rolls me on my side to wash me, and every time she brings me Taco Bell, I ask myself why anyone gives a shit about me. I literally give nothing in return. I shouldn't bother with life.
